description: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi (RA4M1, Cortex-M4), stock 16 KiB DFU layout and Arduino Renesas provider layer

firmware_generation.entry: cortex-m-rt vector table with RA4M1 default handlers
firmware_generation.interrupts: the application owns vectors after the stock 16 KiB DFU region; providers must declare ICU and NVIC ownership
firmware_generation.dma: GPT, ELC, DMAC, and ICU ownership is opt-in and never generated from a task name
firmware_generation.clock: the generated contract-only image configures no clock and claims no timing provider; provider-bearing firmware uses the maintained RA4M1 runtime
firmware_generation.boot: stock UNO R4 bootloader; generated application origin is exactly 0x4000
